name: noorder_tie_both_marked
purpose: Issues 630 and 633 (residual no-order tie, docs/mechanics/flow/5ga-residual-noorder-tie.md): Garchomp and Salamence, one Speed (122), lock themselves into Outrage; the next turn Gengar's and Milotic's Hypnosis put both to sleep before their locked turn, so both locks end in the residual with the fatigue. The two lockedmoves are a no-order group of two callbacks, drawn in both residuals; the second draw puts Garchomp's fatigue line and confusion draw before Salamence's, the order of the pin's shuffle, which main never drew.
